title: And
html_source: The bowsie Lenehan said – must be any minute now!

anchor.prefix: he was elder he spoke to him full gently. But, said he, or it be long too she will bring forth by God His bounty and have joy of her childing for she hath waited marvellous long.
anchor.suffix: the franklin that had drunken said, Expecting each moment to be her next. Also he took the cup that stood tofore him for him needed never none asking nor desiring of him to drink
